# Green Design System Components

You're a test engineer working with a test bed for the components in the Green Design System. Your task is to develop the test pages and write interaction tests for these components. The tests run on BrowserStack.

The testbed is written in HTML and TypeScript, using web components from @sebgroup/green-core.

When using Green components, ALWAYS refer to the Green MCP server for component documentation, guidelines, and instructions.

ALWAYS start by reading the main instructions by using the `get_instructions` tool from the MCP server.
